read.thesis: Gas turbine backlog plus slot reservations rose from 83 to 100 GW with a 110 GW year-end target, and 2026 guidance was raised on revenue, margin and FCF, though capacity additions were not discussed.

capex.quote: Invested $0.4 billion in capital expenditures, including to increase production in Power and Electrification, as part of its commitment to invest $6 billion in capex from 2025 through 2028

triggers.label: Gas backlog+slots 83→100 GW
triggers.quote: Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements grew from 83 to 100 GW; now anticipate reaching at least 110 GW by year-end 2026

triggers.label: Gas Power price and volume drove margin
triggers.quote: primarily driven by price and volume at Gas Power, partially offset by the impact of inflation

triggers.label: FCF guide raised to $6.5-7.5B
triggers.quote: free cash flow* of $6.5-$7.5 billion, up from $5.0-$5.5 billion

triggers.label: Electrification orders +86% organic
triggers.quote: $7.1 billion increased +86% organically, driving a book-to-bill ratio of approximately 2.5

guidance.quote: expects revenue of $44.5-$45.5 billion, up from $44-45 billion
adjusted EBITDA margin* of 12%-14%, up from 11%-13%
free cash flow* of $6.5-$7.5 billion, up from $5.0-$5.5 billion

guidance.metric: Gas turbine backlog plus slot reservations
guidance.quote: now anticipate reaching at least 110 GW by year-end 2026

guidance.value: down low-double digits; ~$400M segment EBITDA losses
guidance.quote: Organic revenue* down low-double digits and approximately $400 million of segment EBITDA losses.

red_flags.label: Net income inflated by $4.5B M&A gain
red_flags.quote: inclusive of $4.5 B pre-tax M&A net gains, primarily from Prolec GE

red_flags.label: Wind EBITDA loss widened
red_flags.quote: Segment EBITDA losses grew from lower Onshore Wind equipment volume and the impact of tariffs
